_comments: THE HOURLY ACTIVITY SYNC. MJ's SchedulingEngine is the mechanism — no external cron.
· JobTypeID — the seeded Action type (ActionScheduledJobDriver). The job does not contain
logic; it invokes Common.SyncActivities, which keeps the schedule and the work separable.
· CronExpression `0 0 * * * *` — SIX fields, seconds first, so this is the top of every hour.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip — overlapping runs would fetch the same window twice. Dedupe absorbs
the writes; two runs racing to advance the same watermark can leave it behind.
· MissedRunPolicy RunOnce — not RunAll. There is no date filter on the fetch, so catching up
ten missed hours would make ten identical requests for the most recent N messages.
SAFE TO SHIP Active: Graph refuses live fetch until an Application Access Policy exists, so an
hourly run writes nothing until a deployment opts in. A host with no connection reports
OwnerUserID and NotifyUserID are left NULL: naming a person here would seed one deployment's
Configuration is a native JSON object (MJ/metadata/CLAUDE.md §1c). No sync block.

fields.Name: Common — Activity Sync (hourly)
fields.Description: Pulls messages and calendar items for every Active-or-Error activity-sync connection and files the relevant ones as Activities. Downstream apps enrich in-stream; they do not own this job.
